TheodoreRattie.title: Funding provided in part by the family of Theodore E. Rattie
TheodoreRattie.description: While serving with the US Army Signal Corps Joint Assault Signals team in the Pacific during World War II, Staff Sgt Rattie made five amphibious landings, deploying communications equipment similar to the SCR-399 in support of Marine Corps invasion forces. Sgt Rattie was awarded the Bronze Star for his actions during combat operations in the Philippines.
